_comment: Language configuration for Claude Code agents. Edit this to match your project.
_agent_language_help: Language for agent output: responses, commit messages, code reviews, documentation. Set to the language you want Claude to communicate in.
_content_languages_help: Languages supported in user-facing content. The translate agent will ensure all these languages have entries in the dictionary/locale files.
_primary_help: The source language — strings are written in this language first, then translated to others.

style_notes.English: Professional register. Use British English spelling (colour, organisation, etc.).
style_notes.Polish: Formal register (Pan/Pani). Proper diacritics (ą, ć, ę, ł, ń, ó, ś, ź, ż). No machine-translation artifacts.
